statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with sick sinus syndrome
The patient requires continuous rhythm monitoring to evaluate for bradyarrhythmias or pauses
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is indicated to assess for potential cardioembolic sources such as paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis code I49.5 is associated with this case
The diagnosis code Z86.73 is associated with this case
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
